Detailed Description

◆ QDMI_Device

typedef struct QDMI_Device_impl_d* QDMI_Device

Opaque type for a device.

A handle for an implementation of the QDMI device interface. It is implementation-defined how the device is represented and how the symbols provided by the implementation are made available to the client.

This type is implemented by the driver.

◆ QDMI_Session

typedef struct QDMI_Session_impl_d* QDMI_Session

Opaque type for a QDMI session.

A handle for making devices (QDMI_Device) available to a client. It is implementation-defined how the session is represented and how the session manages the devices it has access to.

This type is implemented by the driver.
